title: Wren and the Echo
author: C. M. Vane
blurb: Sebastian Thornbury, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
